# SD18 deterministic Human Fighter level 16 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Fighter pilot from the bounded
# level 15 (Armor Training 4) tranche to level 16 as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
# It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and the deterministic
# Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 16 IS a Fighter
# bonus-feat cadence level (1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, ...), so this
# fixture adds an eighth named bonus-feat choice slot
# (choice:fighter_bonus_feat_16, canonically Critical Focus, whose
# prerequisite -- base attack bonus +9 -- is honestly met by the level-16
# base attack bonus of +16). It is NOT a Weapon Training rank-rise level
# (rank stays 3; the next rise is level 17) and NOT an Armor Training
# rank-rise level (rank stays 4; Armor Training has no fifth rank in the PF1
# Core Rulebook), so no new weapon-training-group or armor-training choice is
# added.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-fighter-level16-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:fighter:16
ability=strength:16

ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8

feat=feat:dodge

feat=feat:greater_weapon_specialization
feat=feat:critical_focus
skill=skill:climb:1
skill=skill:intimidate:1
skill=skill:swim:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active

equipment=item:shield:absent
equipment=power_attack:selected_inactive
